notes.general_comments:
The mean percentage score of 47.9% recorded on this paper was some 5% points higher than candidates
have achieved on corresponding papers in recent years, and only one of the questions, Question 18, had a
facility score below the 25% i.e. the guessing level for four-option items. However, there were no fewer than
eight Questions, 4, 5, 7, 11, 13, 19, 21, and 23 where there was very little correlation between those opting
for the correct response and the performance of candidates on the paper overall, and, as a result, these
questions had discrimination scores which were below the test design limit.
